description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [MAG +30%, RES +25% (25s)], [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Awoken Earth], [Damage Cap +10000], [Earth Ability Instant Cast (15s)], and [Rockslide VIII Finisher] to the user

description.name: Awoken Earth
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Earth Ability Instant Cast (15s)
description.text: Instant cast speed for Earth abilities

description.name: Rockslide VIII Finisher
description.text: Casts Rockslide VIII when [Awoken Earth] is removed
